reuse.why: Holiday recognition and date movement reuse shared helpers, but both server handlers independently reproduce the daily skip policy implemented in getNextDate.

duplication.why: Daily occurrence filtering is repeated across three functions, and the holiday-dependent occurrence allowance is repeated in getNextDate and getUpcomingDates.

placement.why: Holiday primitives belong in shared/schedules.ts, but schedule policy also spreads into server handlers and budget-template orchestration.

scope.why: The implementation, model changes, tests and release notes all address the four requested scheduling changes.

maintainability.why: Maintainers must coordinate several daily-policy implementations, caller-side disabling of weekend adjustment and duplicated occurrence-sizing assumptions.

bypasses_abstraction.where: server/schedules/app.ts:getDatesInRange and getUpcomingDates implement daily skip-versus-move decisions independently of shared/schedules.ts:getNextDate.

disguised_duplication.where: The daily filtering decision appears as an isKept predicate in getNextDate, a filter/slice pipeline in getUpcomingDates and a continue branch in getDatesInRange.

abstraction_drift.where: Holiday support adds a getDateWithSkippedWeekend argument and a WeekendRule option; getNextDate adds daily-specific filtering, take sizing and an early return, while both server handlers independently implement the same daily policy.
